brand.name: SOPHIE
brand.aesthetic: Minimalist luxury, Apple + Zara inspired UI, purely white background, high contrast black typography, sharp edges or very subtle rounding, lots of whitespace.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Playfair Display, or Bodoni Moda

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Apple-like), structured modular grids (Zara-like). Let the photography be the hero.
spacing_and_layout.edges: rounded-none or very subtle rounded-sm for an editorial/luxury feel.

components.navbar: Sticky at top. Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80` or solid white with a subtle `border-b border-[#F3F4F6]`. Minimal text links centered. Icons for Search, User, Cart on the right. Hamburger for mobile.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid black `#111111` background, white text, sharp edges `rounded-none`, hover state `bg-[#333333] transition-colors`. Secondary: Transparent with `border border-[#111111]`, black text, hover `bg-gray-50`.
components.product_card: Image dominates. Minimalist text below (Brand, Name, Price in left-aligned stack). Hover effect: Secondary image cross-fade. Quick Add button appears on hover over image.
components.cart_drawer: Slide-in from right. Clean layout. Image + Name + Size/Color + Qty controls. Fixed bottom section for Subtotal and Checkout button.
components.filters: Sidebar or top accordion for Product Listing Page. Minimalist checkboxes, price slider. Sort dropdown should be clean without heavy outlines.
components.inputs: Underlined inputs or fully bordered with `#F3F4F6`. Focus state `border-[#111111] ring-0`.

animations.hover: Subtle opacity shifts or smooth image swaps on product cards. Slow, deliberate.
animations.page_load: Fade in and slight upward translation (`framer-motion` y: 20 to 0) for headers and staggered grid items.
animations.interactions: Smooth easing, Apple-like fluidity. Menus and drawers should slide elegantly.

media.instructions: Use these exact image URLs for the respective sections to maintain the high-fashion editorial aesthetic. DO NOT use placeholder text or dummy image services.

hero_carousel.description: Young woman in black dress, perfect for main Hero banner
Stylish woman portrait, great for secondary hero or featured collection

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="cart-checkout-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous whitespace. Ensure sections do not feel cramped.

Use Radix UI / Shadcn for complex interactive components (Select, Accordion, Dialog) but strip away default Vercel-like styles to match the minimalist luxury aesthetic (remove heavy borders, use pure black/white).
For the 4-column product grid, ensure responsive scaling (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 4 col desktop).
Implement image hover swapping natively using Tailwind group-hover on the product card container.
All interactive elements MUST have hover states (opacity change, background change, or subtle transform).
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, links, inputs, and major sections.
